author: Cecilia B
text: Thomas came out within the hour during a holiday. We needed urgent help, and he is the only one that called us back,  when we didn't expect anyone to help during the holidays.  He is very knowledgeable and gave us tips throughout the process.  Excellent service!

author: Autumn Esparza
text: Mr. Thomas! You are the epitome of excellence, sir. You turned our incredibly stressful day into a pretty great one. Your service and personality are top notch! We had an emergency and you came straight out and even explained everything to my husband. Definitely went above and beyond and we will never use anyone but you for our septic needs. Thank you so much!

author: Adam Nathan
text: Extremely professional and polite. Great communication skills. Very experienced and conducted a thorough inspection for our home with a detailed report. Highly recommend working with 662 Septic for any work in north Mississippi.

author: Keaton Ross
text: I'm a local home inspector and I've seen many septic inspections performed. This company by far does a WAY more comprehensive septic inspection than any other company I've seen. No corners cut. This is the guy to call

author: Lisa Duncan
text:
I had never had my septic tank serviced and I found them on line, called and Thomas answered right away and had an appointment set up within minutes.
He showed up promptly and gave a very reasonable price.
So glad I found an honest and trustworthy person, and will definitely continue to request his services when needed.
